ai.seo_question: Who were drowned in the story of the Pharaoh?
ai.summary: In Surah As-Saff, this verse serves as a concluding reminder of the ultimate fate of the disbelievers, contrasting their drowning with the salvation of the faithful. It reinforces the theme of divine justice, illustrating how Allah's power manifests in both preserving the believers and destroying their adversaries, a motif frequently cited in Shia exegesis to highlight the certainty of the final outcome.
